And I've said "We discussed about collabbing with another team on some of our projects, and that should help us both in getting stuff done, let's hope everything will go smooth about it~!" ...Turns out it did not go smooth, and we got no news from them for over a month... so, I decided to redirect all the stuck projects so now we're slowly getting to deal with the backlog. Hopefully I can present you more news uploads soon.

This is a doujin in an anthology, that is a real gold mine! Like 24 carat stuff, it's really awesome, and so I translated 3 doujins in a row - another one is being typeset already too - and planning to translate more, once we cleared out the backlog.

Now now, as for the doujin itself, let's see... Honoka-chan is soooo kyuuute! But like a proofreader pointed out, "she's surprisinly assertive" XD lol. As for the protagonist Yuri-nerd, spirited away into Hiyori onee-sama's role, her struggle makes much sense "not wanting to defile Honoka with a "filthy dick"" "protecting the purity of yuri", but as it turns out, it's really a fair bit more complex, and once she properly considered Honoka's feelings, she started to see things in a different light. And I suppose the experience changed her in more ways than one. Indeed, like the author's note at the end, hentai doujins can be part about understanding ourselves or others too. I think that's a really awesome thing as well. Lol XD

By the way, said notes were indeed most likely made prior to the creation of these stories and the anthology itself, as the character designs are notably different, and this is not the first doujin in the finished anthology. That's kind of interesting too, I think. XD

Anyway, enough blabbering, right?
I hope you enjoy reading it~!
